## Risk boundaries

- Semantic change proposed? YES / NO (YES blocks normal merge and requires escalation)
- Provider adoption/change? YES / NO (YES requires a separately authorized provider decision)
- Migration/live-data effect? YES / NO (live execution is not authorized by an ordinary PR)
- Security/trust-boundary effect? YES / NO
- Player/epistemic/authority impact? YES / NO
